lede.zh: 从一格格的数开始，按课程的顺序把计算机视觉的概念一个个搭出来：滤波、边缘、频率、颜色，再到卷积网络、匹配、深度、注意力、分割、检测和生成。想深挖原理、想做真实场景，都在支线里。
lede.en: Starting from a grid of numbers, build computer vision’s ideas one by one in the course’s order: filtering, edges, frequency, colour, then convolutional networks, matching, depth, attention, segmentation, detection and generation. The principles underneath and the real-world scenes are side branches.

question.zh: 一张图怎样靠邻居变干净、找出边？
question.en: How do neighbours clean an image and find its edges?

t.zh: 一张图是一格格的数：0 是黑，1 是白。<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
t.en: An image is a grid of numbers: 0 is black, 1 is white. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 每格只看自己、各算各的，这叫<wiki-ref to="point-op"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Each cell looks only at itself, each worked out on its own: a <wiki-ref to="point-op"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 把图变成底片：亮的变暗，暗的变亮。
brief.en: Make the image a negative: bright turns dark, dark turns bright.

hint.zh: 看一格：0 要变成 1，1 要变成 0，0.2 要变成多少？
hint.en: Take one cell: 0 must become 1, 1 must become 0; what must 0.2 become?

naiveWhy.zh: 图减 1 处处是负数：底片是 1 减去图。
naiveWhy.en: The image minus 1 is negative everywhere: the negative is 1 minus the image.

t.zh: 一格乱跳的读数叫噪点。只看自己的运算压不住它：得看看周围。
t.en: A reading that jumps on its own is noise. An operation that looks only at its own cell cannot calm it: it has to look around.

after.zh: 滤波器把每格换成周围九格的加权和，九个权重叫<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>。九格一样重，就是<wiki-ref to="neighbourhood-average"></wiki-ref>：噪点压平了，边也软了。
after.en: A filter replaces each cell with a weighted sum of the nine around it; the nine weights are its <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>. Nine equal weights make a <wiki-ref to="neighbourhood-average"></wiki-ref>: the noise is flattened, and the edges soften too.

brief.zh: 让输出和目标一样：噪点压平，亮度不变。
brief.en: Match the target: noise flattened, brightness unchanged.

hint.zh: 滤波器的输出每格是九个邻居乘上核里对应的数再相加。
hint.en: Each cell of the filter’s output is its nine neighbours times the matching numbers of the kernel, added up.

hint.zh: 一整片同样亮的地方，输出要和输入一样亮：九个权重加起来是多少？
hint.en: Where the image is one brightness, the output must be as bright: what must the nine weights add up to?

naiveWhy.zh: 九个权重都是 1，每格成了九格的和：整张图亮了九倍。
naiveWhy.en: Nine weights of 1 make each cell the sum of nine: the whole image nine times as bright.

t.zh: 模糊把边变软。反过来，能不能让边更利？
t.en: Blurring softens the edges. The other way round: can the edges be made crisper?

after.zh: 原图减去模糊，剩下的是模糊抹掉的那部分：<wiki-ref to="sharpen"></wiki-ref>就是把这份细节按强度加回去。
after.en: The image minus its blur is exactly what blurring removed: <wiki-ref to="sharpen"></wiki-ref>ing adds that detail back, as strongly as asked.

brief.zh: 让输出和目标一样。强度 0 时原样输出，越大边越利。
brief.en: Match the target. At strength 0 the image comes out as it is; the larger, the crisper the edges.

hint.zh: 原图和它模糊后的样子差在哪？差出来的就是细节。
hint.en: Where do the image and its blur differ? The difference is the detail.
Blur with the kernel of <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref>.

naiveWhy.zh: 这张现成的锐化核强度是固定的，强度 0 时也照样锐化。
naiveWhy.en: This ready-made sharpening kernel has one fixed strength: it sharpens even at strength 0.

t.zh: 一台滤波器装在盒子里，看不到它的核。只能喂图进去，看出来什么。
t.en: A filter sits sealed in a box; its kernel cannot be seen. All you can do is feed it images and watch what comes out.

after.zh: 一个亮点进去，出来的就是它的核，叫<wiki-ref to="impulse-response"></wiki-ref>。这台中间最重，越往外越轻。
after.en: One bright dot in, and out comes its kernel: the <wiki-ref to="impulse-response"></wiki-ref>. This one weighs the centre most and less further out.

brief.zh: 填一张能分清三种说法的图，再选输出支持的那一种。
brief.en: Fill in an image that tells the three accounts apart, then pick the one the output supports.

hint.zh: 一整片同样亮的图，三种核都不会改变它。
hint.en: An image of one brightness all over is left unchanged by all three.

hint.zh: 想看清它对每个邻居做了什么，就让只有一格是亮的。
hint.en: To see what it does with each neighbour, light just one cell.

t.zh: 模糊和锐化都在改一张图；这一回，只想知道它哪里在变。
t.en: Blurring and sharpening both change an image; this time the question is only where it changes.

after.zh: 右边减左边、下边减上边：这叫<wiki-ref to="derivative"></wiki-ref>。平的地方是 0，变亮为正、变暗为负，边就是差大的地方。
after.en: Right minus left, below minus above: a <wiki-ref to="derivative"></wiki-ref>. Flat is 0, brightening positive, darkening negative, and the edges are where the difference is large.

brief.zh: 输出横向和竖向的变化：变亮为正，变暗为负，平的地方为 0。
brief.en: Output the change across and the change down: brightening positive, darkening negative, flat 0.

hint.zh: 核可以有负数：负的那一格是减去的。
hint.en: A kernel can hold negative numbers: that neighbour is subtracted.

hint.zh: 只和一边比，变化会偏到那一边；两边都看，它才落在台阶正中。
hint.en: Comparing with one side pulls the change to that side; looking at both puts it in the middle of the step.

naiveWhy.zh: 只和一边的邻居比：台阶被标在了它的一侧，左右不对称。
naiveWhy.en: Comparing with one neighbour only marks the step on one side of it, lopsided.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-5"></level-ref>的电路放到带噪点的图上，满屏都是假边。
t.en: Put the circuit of <level-ref to="1-5"></level-ref> on a noisy image and false edges are everywhere.

after.zh: 相减把噪点放大了。先沿边的方向用 1、2、1 平滑，再垂直于边相减，合成一张核：<wiki-ref to="sobel"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Subtracting amplified the noise. Smooth along the edge with 1, 2, 1 first, then subtract across it, all in one kernel: the <wiki-ref to="sobel"></wiki-ref>.

desc.zh: 一张图的横向和竖向变化（Sobel）。
desc.en: An image’s change across and change down (Sobel).

brief.zh: 让输出和目标一样：只剩真正的边。
brief.en: Match the target: only the real edges left.

hint.zh: 相减时，噪点也被减了出来。先压一压噪点再相减。
hint.en: Subtracting brings the noise out too. Calm the noise before subtracting.

hint.zh: 只沿着边的方向平滑，边就不会被抹宽；中间那行重一些，1、2、1。
hint.en: Smooth only along the edge so it does not widen; weigh the middle row more, 1, 2, 1.

naiveWhy.zh: 没改：每个噪点都成了一对一正一负的假边。
naiveWhy.en: Unchanged: every noisy cell becomes a pair of false edges, one positive and one negative.

t.zh: 一条斜着的边，在横、竖两张变化图里各只出现一半。
t.en: A slanted edge shows up only half in each of the two change maps.

after.zh: 横、竖两个变化合成一个箭头：<wiki-ref to="gradient"></wiki-ref>。长度是边有多陡，方向指向变亮最快的一边，和边垂直。
after.en: The two changes make one arrow: the <wiki-ref to="gradient"></wiki-ref>. Its length is how steep the edge is; it points the way brightness rises fastest, across the edge.

brief.zh: 输出每格边的强弱，和它朝哪边变亮（以周为单位）。
brief.en: Output each cell’s edge strength and which way it brightens (in turns).

t.zh: 强弱是一张深浅不一的图；要的是一句话：这一格是不是边。
t.en: Strength is an image of many shades; what is wanted is a yes or no: is this cell an edge?

after.zh: 强弱过了门槛就算边：这张只有 0 和 1 的图叫<wiki-ref to="edge-map"></wiki-ref>。门槛低了噪点也算边，高了弱的边会断。
after.en: Strong enough counts as an edge: this image of only 0 and 1 is an <wiki-ref to="edge-map"></wiki-ref>. Too low a threshold lets noise in; too high breaks the weak edges.

desc.zh: 强弱超过门槛的格子标 1，其余标 0。
desc.en: 1 where the edge strength exceeds the threshold, 0 elsewhere.

brief.zh: 边的强弱超过「门槛」的格子标 1，其余标 0。
brief.en: Mark 1 where the edge strength exceeds “threshold”, 0 elsewhere.

naiveWhy.zh: 只看了横向变化：上下方向的边和变暗的边都丢了。
naiveWhy.en: Only the change across: edges running sideways, and darkening edges, are lost.

t.zh: 修图软件有几款滤镜，只给了处理前后的照片。滤波器已经接好，填出每款滤镜的核。
t.en: A photo app has a few filters, and all it shows is before and after. The filter is wired; fill in each one’s kernel.

after.zh: 亮点经过滤波器，出来的是核转了 180°：<wiki-ref to="impulse-response"></wiki-ref>要转回来才是核。
after.en: A bright dot through the filter comes out as the kernel turned 180°: the <wiki-ref to="impulse-response"></wiki-ref> must be turned back to give the kernel.

brief.zh: 填出「柔化」的核。
brief.en: Fill in the kernel of “soften”.

naiveWhy.zh: 九个 1 把图亮了九倍。
naiveWhy.en: Nine ones make the image nine times as bright.

brief.zh: 填出「浮雕」的核。
brief.en: Fill in the kernel of “emboss”.

naiveWhy.zh: 照抄了亮点的输出：滤波器的冲激响应是核转了 180°，效果上下左右都颠倒了。
naiveWhy.en: This copies the bright dot’s output: the filter’s impulse response is the kernel turned 180°, so the effect comes out upside down and mirrored.

brief.zh: 填出「描边」的核。
brief.en: Fill in the kernel of “outline”.

naiveWhy.zh: 只减了上下左右四个邻居：斜对角的变化漏掉了。
naiveWhy.en: Only the four side neighbours are subtracted: diagonal changes are missed.

t.zh: 一块别人搭的去噪电路，输出四周一圈发黑。图的边上，滤波器要读的邻居有一些在图外。
t.en: Someone else’s denoising circuit leaves a dark band round every output. At the edge, some of the neighbours the filter reads lie outside the picture.

after.zh: 图外没有观测，滤波器只能假设那里是什么：补 0、延续边缘、循环、镜像，各是一种<wiki-ref to="border"></wiki-ref>。对不对，看图外实际是什么。
after.en: Nothing was observed outside the picture, so the filter can only assume what is there: zero, the edge continued, wrapped around, or mirrored, each a <wiki-ref to="border"></wiki-ref>. Which is right depends on what really lies outside.

brief.zh: 单据四周是同样的纸。去掉黑框。
brief.en: The document is surrounded by more of the same paper. Remove the dark band.

naiveWhy.zh: 图外取 0，等于假设纸外面是黑的。
naiveWhy.en: Reading zero outside assumes the paper is black beyond the edge.

brief.zh: 地砖的花纹一块块重复，照片正好拍下一整块。让边上和中间一样。
brief.en: The floor tiles repeat block after block, and the photo holds exactly one block. Make the edge match the middle.

naiveWhy.zh: 花纹是重复的：图外接着的是另一边。
naiveWhy.en: The pattern repeats: beyond one edge comes the other side.

t.zh: 夜里拍的单据，纸放得也不正。画出纸的边。
t.en: A document photographed at night, lying askew. Draw the paper’s edges.

after.zh: 先降噪，再找边：边缘检测器只认强弱，分不出纸边和噪点；先压掉噪点，剩下的才是纸。
after.en: Denoise, then find edges: the edge detector only knows strength and cannot tell the paper’s edge from noise; calm the noise first and what is left is the paper.

brief.zh: 让输出和目标一样：纸边标 1，字和噪点不算。
brief.en: Match the target: the paper’s edges marked 1, not the text or the noise.

naiveWhy.zh: 没有先降噪：字和噪点也越过了门槛。
naiveWhy.en: No denoising first: text and noise cross the threshold too.

t.zh: 相机传感器三列一组轮流读数，组里三列的灵敏度各不相同：拍下的单据满是竖纹。
t.en: The camera’s sensor reads its columns in groups of three, and the three differ in sensitivity: the document photos are full of vertical streaks.

after.zh: 横着平均正好一个周期，三列的偏差加起来抵消；不往上下平均，字就不糊。
after.en: Averaging across exactly one period makes the three columns’ errors cancel; not averaging up and down keeps the text sharp.

brief.zh: 让输出和目标一样：竖纹去掉，字不糊。
brief.en: Match the target: streaks gone, text still sharp.

naiveWhy.zh: 九格平均也压住了竖纹，但字被上下抹开了。
naiveWhy.en: The nine-cell average calms the streaks too, but smears the text up and down.

t.zh: 滤波器里面是怎么算的？先不用它，只用平移和四则运算，让每格和左右邻居平均。
t.en: What goes on inside the filter? Without it, using only shifts and arithmetic, average each cell with its left and right neighbours.

after.zh: 平移把整张图挪一格，每格上放的就是邻居：「读邻居」不过是挪过一格的整张图。
after.en: A shift moves the whole image one cell, leaving each cell holding its neighbour: reading a neighbour is just the image moved by one.

desc.zh: 每格和它前后两格平均。方向可以选横或竖。
desc.en: Each cell averaged with the two beside it, across or down.

brief.zh: 每格换成它和左右两格的平均（图外延续边缘）。
brief.en: Replace each cell with the average of itself and its left and right neighbours (the edge continued outside).

hint.zh: 平移完以后，每格上放的是它旁边那一格的读数。
hint.en: After a shift each cell holds the reading of the one beside it.

naiveWhy.zh: 只和一边的邻居平均，整张图往那一边偏了半格。
naiveWhy.en: Averaging with one neighbour only shifts the image half a cell that way.

t.zh: 滤波器按核写下的样子直接对上去。数学书里的卷积却要先把核转 180°。
t.en: The filter lays the kernel on as written. The convolution of the textbooks turns the kernel 180° first.

after.zh: 滤波器算的是<wiki-ref to="correlation"></wiki-ref>；核转 180° 再滤波就是<wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>。对称的核两者一样，不对称的效果颠倒。
after.en: The filter computes <wiki-ref to="correlation"></wiki-ref>; turning the kernel 180° first gives <wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>. A symmetric kernel gives the same either way; an asymmetric one comes out reversed.

brief.zh: 输出图和核的卷积。
brief.en: Output the convolution of the image with the kernel.

hint.zh: 一个亮点做卷积，出来的就是核本身。
hint.en: Convolving a bright dot gives back the kernel itself.

naiveWhy.zh: 直接滤波是互相关：不对称的核效果上下左右颠倒。
naiveWhy.en: Filtering directly is correlation: an asymmetric kernel comes out upside down and mirrored.

t.zh: 有的核拆不成先横后竖，比如锐化。用三点加权搭出能装任意 3×3 核的滤波器。
t.en: Some kernels cannot be split into across-then-down, sharpening for one. Build a filter for any 3×3 kernel from three-point weighting.

after.zh: 核的每一行交给一个三点加权，先把图上下挪好对上那一行，三者相加：和预设的滤波器逐格一样。
after.en: Give each row of the kernel to a three-point weighting, with the image moved up or down to meet that row, and add the three: cell for cell the preset filter.

brief.zh: 输出和预设的滤波器一样（核的左上角乘左上方的邻居）。
brief.en: Output the same as the preset filter (the kernel’s top left weighs the neighbour above left).

naiveWhy.zh: 用中间那行先横后竖：锐化这种核拆不开，四角和上下的权重都对不上。
naiveWhy.en: The middle row across then down: a kernel like sharpening does not split, so the corners and the top and bottom rows come out wrong.

t.zh: 三点平均只看一行。九格平均能不能用它拼出来？
t.en: The three-point average looks along one line. Can the nine-cell average be built from it?

after.zh: 横着平均一次、竖着再平均一次，就是九格平均，乘法从 9 次降到 6 次：这样的核是<wiki-ref to="separable"></wiki-ref>的。
after.en: Averaging across once and down once is the nine-cell average, with 6 multiplications instead of 9: such a kernel is <wiki-ref to="separable"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 输出和滤波器的九格平均一样。
brief.en: Output the same as the filter’s nine-cell average.

naiveWhy.zh: 只横着平均：上下的邻居没算进去。
naiveWhy.en: Across only: the neighbours above and below are left out.

t.zh: 滤波器的九格不一定一样重。先让三点平均能给左、中、右不同的权重。
t.en: A filter’s nine weights need not be equal. First let the three-point average weigh left, centre and right differently.

after.zh: 平均只是三个权重都是三分之一的<wiki-ref to="weighted-sum"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: An average is just the <wiki-ref to="weighted-sum"></wiki-ref> whose three weights are all a third.

desc.zh: 每格和它前后两格按三个权重相加。方向可以选横或竖。
desc.en: Each cell and the two beside it added by three weights, across or down.

brief.zh: 每格换成左、中、右三格按「权重」（前、中、后）的加权和。
brief.en: Replace each cell with left, centre and right weighted by “weights” (first, centre, last).

naiveWhy.zh: 只用了中间的权重：左右邻居没算进去。
naiveWhy.en: Only the centre weight: the left and right neighbours are missing.

body.zh: 一张数字图像是一格格的数，每一格叫一个像素：灰度图一格一个数，越大越亮；彩色图一格三个数（红、绿、蓝）。坐标从左上角 (0, 0) 起，x 向右、y 向下。COMP90086 第 2 讲。
body.en: A digital image is a grid of numbers; each cell is a pixel. A grey image has one number a cell, larger being brighter; a colour image three (red, green, blue). Coordinates start at (0, 0) in the top left, x to the right and y downwards. COMP90086 lecture 2.

body.zh: 每个像素的新值只由它自己的旧值决定：反相、调亮度、调对比度、门槛都是。点运算改不了噪点，因为它看不到邻居。第 3 讲。
body.en: Each pixel’s new value depends only on its own old value: negatives, brightness, contrast and thresholds are all point operations. A point operation cannot remove noise, because it never sees the neighbours. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 滤波器用的权重表，常见的是 3×3 或 5×5。中心那格对应当前像素，其余对应它的邻居。权重加起来是 1，平坦处亮度不变；加起来是 0，平坦处输出 0。第 3 讲。
body.en: The table of weights a filter uses, commonly 3×3 or 5×5. The centre cell stands for the current pixel and the rest for its neighbours. Weights adding up to 1 keep flat regions as bright; weights adding up to 0 turn them to 0. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 把核的中心对准每一个像素，用核给它周围的像素加权求和，得到这一格的新值。同一张核用在整张图上，所以叫线性、平移不变的滤波。第 3 讲。
body.en: Centre the kernel on every pixel and take the sum of the pixels around it weighted by the kernel: that is the cell’s new value. One kernel is used over the whole image, which makes the filtering linear and shift-invariant. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 每格换成它和周围几格的平均。各格独立的噪声互相抵消一部分，成片的东西留下；代价是边和细节也被抹平一些。第 3 讲。
body.en: Each cell replaced by the average of itself and the cells around it. Noise that differs from cell to cell partly cancels while larger shapes stay; the price is that edges and fine detail are smoothed too. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 原图减去模糊后的图，剩下模糊抹掉的细节（高频）；把细节乘上强度再加回原图，边就更利。也能合成一张核，比如 [0 −1 0; −1 5 −1; 0 −1 0]。第 3 讲。
body.en: The image minus its blur leaves the detail the blur removed (the high frequencies); adding that detail back, times a strength, makes edges crisper. It can also be one kernel, such as [0 −1 0; −1 5 −1; 0 −1 0]. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 只有一格是 1、其余都是 0 的输入叫冲激；一台滤波器对它的输出叫冲激响应，它摆出了滤波器给每个邻居的分量（按互相关计算时转了 180°）。认一台滤波器，喂一个冲激就够了。第 3 讲。
body.en: An input that is 1 in one cell and 0 elsewhere is an impulse; a filter’s output for it is its impulse response, which lays out the share it gives each neighbour (turned 180° when the filter computes correlation). One impulse is enough to identify a filter. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 相邻格的差，图像版的导数：权重 [−1 0 1] 给出右边减左边。平坦处为 0，变亮为正、变暗为负。第 5 讲。
body.en: The difference between neighbouring cells, the image’s derivative: weights [−1 0 1] give right minus left. It is 0 where flat, positive where brightening, negative where darkening. Lecture 5.

body.zh: 沿边的方向用 [1 2 1] 平滑、垂直于边用 [−1 0 1] 求差，合成一张 3×3 的核。平滑压住噪声，差分找出变化。第 5 讲。
body.en: Smoothing along the edge with [1 2 1] and differencing across it with [−1 0 1], combined in one 3×3 kernel. The smoothing keeps noise down; the difference finds the change. Lecture 5.

body.zh: 横、竖两个方向的变化合成的箭头。长度是亮度变化有多陡，方向是变亮最快的方向，和边垂直。第 5 讲。
body.en: The arrow made of the change across and the change down. Its length is how steeply brightness changes; its direction is where it brightens fastest, across the edge. Lecture 5.

body.zh: 梯度大小超过门槛的像素标 1、其余标 0 的图。门槛低了噪声和纹理也算边，高了弱的边会断。第 5 讲。
body.en: An image marking 1 where the gradient’s length exceeds a threshold and 0 elsewhere. Too low a threshold lets noise and texture count as edges; too high breaks weak ones. Lecture 5.

body.zh: 一张二维的核能写成「一列权重 × 一行权重」时，它就是可分离的：先横着用一行权重做一次，再竖着用一列权重做一次，结果相同、乘法更少（3×3 从 9 次降到 6 次）。方块平均和高斯都可分离；锐化、拉普拉斯不行。第 3 讲。
body.en: A two-dimensional kernel is separable when it is a column of weights times a row of weights: one pass across with the row and one down with the column give the same result with fewer multiplications (6 instead of 9 for 3×3). The box average and the Gaussian are separable; sharpening and the Laplacian are not. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 每个量乘上自己的权重再相加。平均是所有权重相等、加起来为 1 的加权和；权重可以是负数，这时那一项是减去的。第 3 讲。
body.en: Each quantity times its own weight, all added. An average is a weighted sum whose weights are equal and add up to 1; a weight can be negative, which subtracts its term. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 核的左上角乘左上方的邻居：按核写下的样子直接对上去求加权和。冲激经过互相关，出来的是核转了 180°。第 3 讲。
body.en: The kernel’s top left weighs the neighbour up and to the left: the weighted sum with the kernel laid on as written. An impulse through correlation comes out as the kernel turned 180°. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 先把核转 180°，再做互相关。冲激经过卷积，出来的就是核本身。对称的核两者一样；不对称的核（浮雕）效果颠倒。第 3 讲。
body.en: Turn the kernel 180°, then correlate. An impulse through convolution comes out as the kernel itself. A symmetric kernel gives the same either way; an asymmetric one (emboss) comes out reversed. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 图的边上，核要读的邻居有一些在图外。图外没有观测，只能假设：补 0、延续边缘、循环、镜像。不同假设只改变边上一圈的结果；哪个对，取决于图外实际是什么。第 3 讲。
body.en: At the image’s edge some neighbours the kernel reads lie outside it. Nothing was observed there, so it must be assumed: zero, the edge continued, wrapped around, or mirrored. The assumption changes only the band along the edge; which is right depends on what really lies outside. Lecture 3.

about.zh: 图外读最近的边上那一格。
about.en: Outside reads the nearest edge cell.
Outside continues from the opposite side.

about.zh: 图外照着边缘镜像，边上那一格也算一次。
about.en: Outside mirrors the edge, the edge cell included.

desc.zh: 把整张图沿横向或竖向挪一格：挪完以后，每格上放的是它旁边那一格的读数。
desc.en: Move the whole picture one cell across or down: afterwards each cell holds its neighbour’s reading.

shift.compute: match $axis { x: match $by { forward: shift(image, vector2(-1, 0), outside=$outside), backward: shift(image, vector2(1, 0), outside=$outside) }, y: match $by { forward: shift(image, vector2(0, -1), outside=$outside), backward: shift(image, vector2(0, 1), outside=$outside) } }

desc.zh: a 和 b 逐格运算；一个数和一张图运算时，这个数用在每一格上。
desc.en: a and b cell by cell; a number with an image applies to every cell.

arithmetic.compute: match $op { add: add(a, b), sub: sub(a, b), mul: mul(a, b), div: div(a, b) }

desc.zh: 一个固定的值：一个数、一行三个权重，或一张 3×3 的核。
desc.en: A fixed value: a number, a row of three weights, or a 3×3 kernel.

const.compute: match $kind { scalar: $value, row3: weightVector($first, $centre, $last), kernel3: kernel3($k1, $k2, $k3, $k4, $k5, $k6, $k7, $k8, $k9) }

desc.zh: 一行三个权重拆成前、中、后三个数。
desc.en: A row of three weights taken apart into first, centre and last.

desc.zh: 3×3 的核拆成上、中、下三行，每行三个权重。
desc.en: A 3×3 kernel taken apart into its top, middle and bottom rows of three weights.

desc.zh: 每格换成它周围九格按核加权的和：核的中间乘这一格，左上角乘左上方的邻居。
desc.en: Each cell replaced by the nine around it weighted by the kernel: the kernel’s centre weighs the cell itself, its top left the neighbour above left.

desc.zh: 把一张图（或一张核）转半圈：左上角到了右下角。
desc.en: Turn an image (or a kernel) half a circle: the top left goes to the bottom right.

desc.zh: 把 x、y 当成箭头的横竖两个分量，给出箭头的长度 √(x² + y²)。
desc.en: Taking x and y as an arrow’s two parts, the arrow’s length √(x² + y²).

desc.zh: 把 x、y 当成箭头的横竖两个分量，给出箭头指的方向，以周为单位：往右 0，往下 1/4，往上 −1/4。
desc.en: Taking x and y as an arrow’s two parts, the way it points, in turns: right 0, down 1/4, up −1/4.

desc.zh: a 小于 b 的格子给 1，其余给 0。
desc.en: 1 where a is less than b, else 0.
